statement: CoWoS-S and CoWoS-L advanced packaging lead times run 52 to 78 weeks as of mid-2026, with a minimum of 52 weeks order-to-delivery and 78 weeks or more for customers outside the top-tier hyperscalers.
why: Order-to-delivery times over a year on the packaging step mean any new accelerator demand today cannot be filled until well into next year, which is the practical ceiling on AI chip supply.

impact.mechanism: Long advanced-packaging lead times delay accelerator deliveries and push smaller buyers to the back of the queue, constraining effective supply.

evidence.excerpt: minimum 52 weeks order-to-delivery; 78+ weeks for non-Tier-1 hyperscaler customers; add 4-6 weeks for peripheral component consolidation in full systems

confidence.basis: Secondary analyst brief; the range is corroborated by one further independently fetched source named inside this document, which is fewer than three distinct publishers across separately fetched documents.

dispersion: Range is 52 to 78 weeks; the recorded value is the stated minimum. Add 4 to 6 weeks for peripheral component consolidation in full systems.
